For characteristic two and odd ell, incidence degree D=ell+1 is zero as a field scalar; summed local vanishing is compatible with total -I_m.
The matrix-to-scalar stable/direct-finiteness distinction and nonsofic consequence conditional on the scalar defect are correctly stated.
CONTENTS.md lines 4518-4527 identify the later torsion-free/F2 claim; inspected lean/docs/197 and KaplanskyFinitelyPresented challenge retain odd-prime torsion. The review distinguishes these scopes.

PDE data class and formal challenge agree on one species, smooth compact nonnegative particle density, finite-energy fields with all bounded derivatives, Gauss constraints, smoothness and compact phase support on finite horizons, and classical uniqueness.
The revised doubling algebra gives a uniform c/(n+1) lower bound, conditional on the signed impulse estimate and bounded-momentum continuation, with datum and fixed horizon dependence preserved.

Wang's actual July 2026 v2/v1 primary abstracts support the comparison to arbitrarily large cylindrically symmetric localized data; the review identifies removal of symmetry within its stated data class rather than generic priority in large-data existence.

Abstract and synthesis keep conclusions within the defined release-claim framework; pi endpoint is explained in the arithmetic body as every nu>2, not c/q^2. No new substantive quantifier mismatch was found in the arithmetic/algebra/PDE synthesis rows.
